Le Ministère ne tombe pas. Aucun régime: The Ministry does not fall. No regime falls because an inspector told the truth one Saturday in December.
Mais le dossier de votre père porte de n: But your father's file once again bears the words that were erased in 1971: the doctored clocks, the stifled inquiry, the name he should never have written. And in basement B, behind a door KREMER never allowed to be sealed, sleep the originals you refused to burn.
On vous surveille, désormais. Vous le sa: You are watched now. You know it. But somewhere in the doctored archive, one line remains true — and it is yours.
VOSK, A., horloger. A découvert en 1971: VOSK, A., clockmaker. Discovered in 1971 that the State's clocks were rigged. Did not emigrate: was silenced. — restored.
Vous n'avez rien dénoncé, rien publié, r: You denounced nothing, published nothing, shouted nothing. You only kept things: the original of the register someone had doctored before handing it to you, and that absurd sheet where VERITAS, fed the real documents, displays "sabotage: 0%".
Un matin, votre casier est vide et votre: One morning, your locker is empty and your badge no longer works. You are not arrested — nobody wants a trial over what you hold. The papers left the Ministry in the lining of a coat.
Quelque part, hors d'atteinte, la preuve: Somewhere, out of reach, the proof exists. It is little. It is all that matters.
MAZUR a pris un train avant qu'on vienne: MAZUR caught a train before they came to relieve him of duty. A platform, a clock, a scribbled word: "true". You understood, and you said nothing.
Vous restez. Inspecteur discret, ni zélé: You stay. A discreet inspector, neither zealous nor suspect, you have learned to read the time the country does not display. Now and then, a clock in a stairwell stops one minute too early: it is a message, and it is for you.
On ne gagne pas. On se tient prêt. L'HEU: Nobody wins. You stay ready. THE TRUE HOUR has one more member.
Vous avez choisi le camp qui ne perd jam: You chose the side that never loses: the one with the keys, the cars and the long memory. A captain owes you his silence, and you owe him yours.
On vous monte. Bureau plus grand, dossie: You rise. A bigger office, heavier files, fewer questions. You sign fast, and well.
Simplement, il existe maintenant, quelqu: Only, somewhere, there is now a file in your name too. Nobody ever told you. Nobody needs to: you know.
Vous avez trop cherché, trop noté, trop: You searched too much, noted too much, hesitated too much. Internal review treats such things as symptoms, not as conscience.
Le dossier 54100 ne se referme pas : il: File 54100 does not close: it grows. Your name, your dates, your hours of service, your father's sealed line. Inspector BRANDT, your neighbour down the corridor, signs the cover with an even stroke.
Vous étiez l'inspecteur. Vous êtes deven: You were the inspector. You have become the subject. The loop closes, as it closed on him.
Vous avez tout signé. SEDLAR, la Central: You signed everything. SEDLAR, the Power Station, and even your own father's file — rewritten by a hand that did not shake. "Emigrated of his own free will." Filed.
Le Ministère vous cite en exemple. Grade: The Ministry holds you up as an example. Higher rank, an office on the first floor, a plaque with your name. On paper, you are perfect: not one contradiction, not one regret, not one gap.
Pas un vide, sauf un. Mais celui-là, vou: Not one gap, except one. But that one you signed yourself, and nobody will ever come to reopen it.
Vous n'avez ni renversé la table ni léch: You neither overturned the table nor licked the boots. You did your job, closed the files, put away the stamps, and on Saturday 6 December you switched off the lamp like every other evening.
Personne ne se souviendra de vous en par: Nobody will remember you in particular. Neither hero nor accomplice: one cog among thousands, which turned without creaking.
Le pays continue. Les horloges aussi. On: The country goes on. So do the clocks. That is all you hear now: the silence, and the ticking behind it.
